about: Thesis claims labelled with the 8-K categories a careful reader would look for (app.core.events). Written by hand on 18 November 2026, before the category rule was written or scored, and not changed after it was scored. Categories: leadership, accounting, deal, restructuring, incident, financing, control, listing. An empty list means no 8-K category bears on the claim. Traps are claims whose words resemble a category's without being about it. `make event-categories` scores the rule against these labels.
